scope: CA01 unit1/2 selected Canticle records; historical exact-head snapshots, not full canon approval

canticle.name: Canticle
canticle.status: Tiny world under a burning sun
canticle.distText: Not on the star chart: position unknown
canticle.blurb: A tiny planet whose sunlight burns anything it touches, so whole cities fly around the world just ahead of the dawn. It spins backwards, rings light its night side, and a firestorm sweeps the sunset line. A stranger called Nomad lands here, hunted from world to world, and is captured by the people of the Cinder King, who rules the cities through power cells called sunhearts.
canticle.short: Cities racing the dawn: The Sunlit Man.

12.blurb: A tiny planet whose sunlight burns anything it touches, so cities fly around the world ahead of the dawn. The stranger Nomad, who is Sigzil of Bridge Four years after leaving Roshar, helps the people of Beacon overthrow the Cinder King, then moves on to another world. Identifying Nomad as Sigzil is a provisional account based on the Coppermind wiki; not independently checked against the book.

sites.name: Union
sites.desc: The largest flying city, which has swallowed most others under the Cinder King.

landmarks.name: The colosseum
landmarks.desc: Union reshapes itself into an arena where captives fight the Charred. Nomad is chained and made to fight here.

landmarks.name: The Hall of Burning
landmarks.desc: Where the Cinder King makes the Charred, people with embers for hearts.

landmarks.name: The command deck
landmarks.desc: The Cinder King controls the joined cities from here. Nomad faces him on Union’s deck and leaves him to the sunlight.

sites.name: Beacon
sites.desc: A smaller flying city that keeps the Chorus, and the heart of the rebellion.

landmarks.name: The Reliquary
landmarks.desc: Home of the Chorus, the shades of Beacon’s dead, who help build its new engines.

landmarks.name: The engines
landmarks.desc: Steam engines that use water for thrust, powered by sunhearts, which let Beacon rise above the thin-air limit and outrun the dawn.

sites.name: The Scadrian research facility
sites.desc: Offworld scientists studying the sunhearts and trading technology for them.

landmarks.name: The Refuge
landmarks.desc: A Scadrian research ship under the surface. Its scientists have worked with the Cinder King and keep a jar of Dor that Nomad needs to escape.

events.title: Nomad lands
events.text: Hunted by the Night Brigade, Nomad arrives on Canticle and is taken prisoner in Union.

events.title: Beacon stands
events.text: Nomad joins Beacon’s rebellion against the Cinder King, racing the sunrise.

events.title: The Refuge
events.text: Scadrian scientists hidden under the surface refuse to help Beacon and keep from Nomad the Dor he needs to leave.

events.title: The Cinder King falls
events.text: Nomad faces the Cinder King on Union’s deck, drains his power and Skips away as the sunlight takes him.
